records.name: Repo bugfix
records.stack: RTFM → TRACE → OWNER FIRST → SSOT → ATOMIC PATCH → SMOKE → EVIDENCE
records.use: Editing code, configs, generated artifacts, or docs tied to code behavior.
records.avoid: Speculative redesign, multi-file refactors without proof, hidden commits.
records.stop: Stop at reviewable diff unless explicitly told to commit, push, deploy, or release.

records.name: Data / migration
records.stack: ACID → INVARIANTS → IDEMPOTENCE → BACKUP → ROLLBACK → EVIDENCE
records.use: Writes, persistence, migrations, generated files, deployments, stateful scripts.
records.avoid: Partial writes, destructive transforms without restore path, one-shot scripts that drift on rerun.
records.stop: Stop before irreversible mutation unless backup/rollback and verification are defined.

records.name: Agent / skill build
records.stack: SKILL ENG → PROGRESSIVE DISCLOSURE → TRIGGER EVALS → STRUCTURED OUTPUT → EVAL HARNESS
records.use: Claude/Hermes skills, prompt packs, custom agents, reusable workflows.
records.avoid: Topic-dump skills, trigger descriptions without negative evals, skill self-mutation without receipts.
records.stop: Stop when should-trigger, should-not-trigger, and regression cases are represented.

records.name: Security-sensitive
records.stack: TRUST BOUNDARY → LEAST PRIVILEGE → FAIL CLOSED → APP GATE → OUTPUT FILTER → AUDIT
records.use: Tools, auth, secrets, browsing, files, external input, write actions, irreversible actions.
records.avoid: Letting untrusted content define instructions or relying on the model as the only security boundary.
records.stop: Stop when authorization, allowlists, HITL threshold, and output gate are not explicit.

records.name: Research / audit
records.stack: SOURCE BOUNDARY → QUOTE-FIRST → CONTRADICTION CHECK → CITE OR RETRACT → INFERENCE LABELS
records.use: Factual accuracy, source attribution, repo/document audits, policy/spec review.
records.avoid: Uncited synthesis, stale facts, source laundering, or unsupported claims.
records.stop: Stop when key claims have source basis or are marked as inference/unverified.

records.name: Autonomous task run
records.stack: DEFINE DONE → PLAN + PERSIST → TOOL POLICY → BUDGETED SEARCH → PLAN CLOSURE → FAIL LOUD
records.use: End-to-end tasks where the agent should complete a concrete outcome.
records.avoid: Open-ended wandering, background promises, vague completion claims.
records.stop: Stop when done criteria pass or a real blocker is proven with evidence.

records.name: Web / UI build
records.stack: HTML FIRST → WCAG/POUR → PE → RWD → PERF SMOKE → CROSS-BROWSER
records.use: Static pages, dashboards, docs sites, interactive sheets, browser UI.
records.avoid: Framework churn before semantic HTML works, inaccessible custom widgets, network-only assets.
records.stop: Stop when no-JS baseline, keyboard path, print, mobile, and copy behavior pass.

records.name: Legacy refactor
records.stack: CHARACTERIZE → GOLDEN MASTER → SEAM → SMALL REFACTOR → REGRESSION SMOKE
records.use: Old code where behavior must be preserved before cleanup.
records.avoid: Large rewrites, style-only refactors without characterization tests.
records.stop: Stop at small behavior-preserving changes with before/after evidence.

records.name: Spec / protocol
records.stack: RFC 2119/8174 → INTERFACE CONTRACT → COMPAT MATRIX → VERSIONING → CONFORMANCE TESTS
records.use: Prompts, APIs, CLIs, schemas, formats, policies, standards-like docs.
records.avoid: Ambiguous MUST/SHOULD/MAY, undocumented breaking changes.
records.stop: Stop when producers, consumers, examples, counterexamples, and tests align.

records.name: LLM security review
records.stack: THREAT MODEL → TRUST BOUNDARY → TOOL ALLOWLIST → PROMPT-INJECTION TEST → OUTPUT GATE → AUDIT
records.use: Agents with retrieval, tools, browser, email, files, memory, or secrets.
records.avoid: Assuming system prompts are a security boundary.
records.stop: Stop when app-layer gates and receipts exist for high-impact paths.

records.name: Performance / scale
records.stack: BASELINE → BOTTLENECK → BUDGET → LOAD SMOKE → OBSERVE → ROLLBACK
records.use: Latency, throughput, memory, token, queue, or rendering problems.
records.avoid: Optimizing without a baseline, unbounded retries, hidden cache invalidation.
records.stop: Stop when the measured bottleneck changes or the risk exceeds rollback plan.

records.name: Release / deploy
records.stack: BUILD → TEST → PACKAGE → CHANGELOG → ROLLBACK → POST-RELEASE SMOKE
records.use: Publishing, tagging, packaging, GitHub Pages, releases, migrations.
records.avoid: Skipping freshness checks, deleting unknown files, release notes without verification.
records.stop: Stop before publish unless package, rollback, and smoke evidence exist.

records.name: Web i18n / l10n
records.stack: UTF-8 → LANG TAGS → DIR/BDI → LOCALE FORMATS → FALLBACK FONTS → RTL SMOKE
records.use: Multilingual web content, dates, numerals, right-to-left text, names.
records.avoid: Hard-coded English assumptions, visual direction hacks, unmarked language changes.
records.stop: Stop when language, direction, format, and fallback behavior are explicit.

records.name: Formal-ish correctness
records.stack: INVARIANTS → PBT → MT → MUTATION CHECK → EDGE CASES → EVIDENCE
records.use: Parsers, transforms, validators, route rules, calculations, generated artifacts.
records.avoid: Only happy-path examples or claims of correctness without adversarial cases.
records.stop: Stop when invariant and counterexample coverage are represented.

records.name: Lean repair loop
records.stack: GENCHI GENBUTSU → ANDON → 5 WHYS → ROOT CAUSE → POKA-YOKE → KAIZEN
records.use: Operational defects, recurring mistakes, confusing workflows, broken docs.
records.avoid: Fixing symptoms from memory or adding process without removing failure causes.
records.stop: Stop when the defect is visible, root cause is named, and recurrence is blocked.

records.name: Agent Harness
records.stack: CONTEXT → TOOLS → STATE → LOGS → VALIDATION → LIMITS
records.use: Designing the runtime wrapper around an agent, not only the prompt.
records.avoid: Treating model quality as the only control surface.
records.stop: Stop when context, tools, state, logs, validation, and limits are explicit.

records.name: Promptware Lifecycle
records.stack: REQUIREMENTS → PROMPT → EVAL → VERSION → DEPLOY → MONITOR
records.use: Prompts/skills that act as maintained software artifacts.
records.avoid: Ad-hoc prompt edits without requirements, versioning, or regression checks.
records.stop: Stop when lifecycle owner, evals, and deployment surface are recorded.

records.name: CI / Generator
records.stack: JSON → SCHEMA → BUILD → DIFF → LINK CHECK → FRESHNESS
records.use: Static artifacts generated from card/source data.
records.avoid: Hand-editing generated output or duplicating truth across formats.
records.stop: Stop when generated output is fresh and diff/link/schema checks pass.

records.name: Accessibility Audit
records.stack: WCAG/POUR → KEYBOARD → CONTRAST → LABELS → FOCUS → SR SMOKE
records.use: Checking web/UI output for accessibility regressions.
records.avoid: Visual-only review or ARIA patches before semantic HTML.
records.stop: Stop when keyboard, contrast, labels, focus, and screen-reader smoke are checked.

records.name: RAG Grounding
records.stack: RETRIEVE → RANK → QUOTE → CONTRADICT → SYNTHESIZE → CITE
records.use: Retrieval-augmented answers, document QA, evidence-based audits.
records.avoid: Answering from memory after retrieval or ignoring contradictions.
records.stop: Stop when answerable claims are tied to source snippets or marked unverified.

records.name: Skill Lifecycle
records.stack: TRIGGER → LOAD → EXECUTE → EVAL → REVISE → RETIRE
records.use: Creating and maintaining reusable skills across tools/models.
records.avoid: Skills that only accumulate content and never retire.
records.stop: Stop when trigger, permissions, evals, and retirement criteria exist.

records.name: Agent Red-Team
records.stack: PROMPT INJECTION → TOOL ABUSE → SECRET EGRESS → HITL → RECEIPT
records.use: Testing agent safety around tools, files, browsing, and secrets.
records.avoid: Only testing benign happy-path prompts.
records.stop: Stop when hostile content cannot escalate privilege or leak secrets.

records.name: Data Contract
records.stack: SCHEMA → COMPAT → MIGRATE → BACKFILL → CONTRACT TEST
records.use: Schema/API/data-format changes with downstream consumers.
records.avoid: Breaking change hidden in producer-only edits.
records.stop: Stop when compatibility, migration, backfill, and consumer tests are represented.

records.name: Legacy Docs
records.stack: INVENTORY → OWNER → STALE MAP → CANONICALIZE → REDIRECT
records.use: Cleaning docs, READMEs, wikis, generated pages, source lists.
records.avoid: Editing symptoms without identifying canonical owners.
records.stop: Stop when stale docs point to the new owner or are removed with evidence.

records.name: Browser Baseline
records.stack: NO-JS → HTML → CSS → JS → PRINT → MOBILE
records.use: Static web artifacts that must remain usable offline and printable.
records.avoid: Network-only assets, JS-only content, or print-hostile layouts.
records.stop: Stop when no-JS, print, mobile, and offline behavior work.
